sql.processStep.getAllForCompany: select psp.id, psp.process_id, psp.process_step_id, ps.process_step_name, ps.parent_company_id, psp.org_id, o.company_id, o.org_name, psp.date_created, psp.date_updated, psp.created_by_id, psp.modified_by_id from flow.process_step_process psp inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = psp.process_step_id inner join flow.org o on o.id = psp.org_id where o.company_id = :companyId
sql.processStep.get: select psp.id, psp.process_id, psp.process_step_id, ps.process_step_name, ps.parent_company_id, psp.org_id, o.company_id, o.org_name, psp.date_created, psp.date_updated, psp.created_by_id, psp.modified_by_id from flow.process_step_process psp inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = psp.process_step_id inner join flow.org o on o.id = psp.org_id where psp.id = :id
sql.processStep.delete: update flow.process_step_process set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_updated = now() where id = :id
